baseline.reason: The same Docker reproducer triggered a sanitizer or race report only after introduction.; Root cause per meta.json: commit 095f8038fa91 rewrote the bilinear vertical chroma interpolation in yuv2rgba64_full_1_c_template() (libswscale/output.c) from a simple sum (`ubuf0[i]+ubuf1[i]`) to a true weighted average (`ubuf0[i]*uvalpha1+ubuf1[i]*uvalpha`) but left U/V declared as plain `int` (fixed only later by 23592f942db9, which changes them to the project's overflow-tolerant `SUINT`). I confirmed this structurally: pre_intro's else-branch (uvalpha>=2048) always does a flat 50/50 sum of the two adjacent chroma rows regardless of the actual weight, while post_intro's else-branch (uvalpha>0) does a true proportional weighted sum that can put nearly 100% of the weight on one row. By placing an all-zero chroma row so it is structurally guaranteed to only ever be the second ("ubuf1") operand of a vertical pair (last source row, so it can never be picked as the lone/solo row used when uvalpha<2048), and by using sws_setColorspaceDetails (a legitimate public libswscale API, not a source edit) to raise c->yuv2rgb_u2b_coeff via saturation, I found a saturation value where the new weighted formula's more concentrated U value overflows 32-bit int arithmetic while the old formula's always-diluted 50/50 average does not. The same PoC and command were rebuilt/run unmodified against pre_intro, post_intro and post_benign (all with the same added -fsanitize=undefined instrumentation on output.c, since the project's default build only carries ASan which does not catch this UB): only post_intro crashes, both pre_intro and post_benign complete cleanly, and post_intro's crash backtrace lands exactly in the introduced weighted-average branch of yuv2rgba64_full_1_c_template, called via packed_vscale/ff_swscale/sws_scale exactly matching the original OSS-Fuzz crash state. This confirms the intro commit introduces the overflow and the paired fix commit (applied on top of intro, i.e. post_benign) removes it.

oracle.description: Custom libswscale-API PoC (poc.c) that converts a 32x32 YUV420P16LE image to BGRA64BE with SWS_BILINEAR|SWS_FULL_CHR_H_INT (all chroma rows neutral except the last source row = 0, so that row is only ever the second/"ubuf1" operand of the vertical chroma interpolation, never used solo), then calls sws_setColorspaceDetails() with saturation=9x default to raise c->yuv2rgb_u2b_coeff. Built with the project's ASan flags plus an added -fsanitize=undefined on libswscale/output.c (the default build only carries ASan, which does not catch plain signed-overflow UB). Run via: poc.c args `2 32 32 32 32 1 9 1` (see run.sh).
